plainText:
Sam Haft is an American actor who works on the English-language dub of . Until , he was credited as Sam Black. He is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Haft is an actor, musician, and songwriter and also works on a few English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. He joined the during . His most notable role so far is that of Kiawe's Marowak.
